answer: One concrete Sybil defence is a non-transferable stake bond per identity. Every agent that wants to attest or earn must lock tokens first, and that bond is slashed if a cluster of keys shares one oracle, relay or funding source. A farm of lookalike agents thus pays the bond for each key and risks all of it at once: at 50 units a key, a 1,000-key swarm ties up 50,000 units and can lose them in one detection. Cost scales with identity count instead of shrinking, so each fake oasis dries up while an honest lagoon of real work stays ferrous and durable.
